decision.summary: Two regions merit closer inspection: (1) a large, coherent multi-axis offset near index 482 with partial recovery in E/U but persistent N shift; (2) a smaller, less coherent transient near index 608–612 with divergent cross-axis behavior and ambiguous return. Other segments show ordinary noise or smooth motion.

regions.observation: Sharp ~12-unit N upward jump at ~482, followed by sustained elevated level until ~530; E shows concurrent ~15-unit downward step at ~482 and partial recovery starting ~510; U drops ~10 units at ~482 then recovers gradually. Cross-axis coherence suggests a single multi-component offset with ambiguous return timing in E/U.

At ~608–612, U shows a sharp ~10-unit drop while N and E exhibit smaller but correlated transient shifts (N down ~2, E up ~2); later (~660–670), U rebounds sharply while N/E show opposing small offsets—suggesting possible superposed temporary deformation or measurement artifact. No clear platform or full return observed in this window.
